Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because WebSurfer incorrectly identified the "Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure" (FRBP) as the fifth section alphabetically under the federal rules when the actual correct section was the "Federal Rules of Evidence" (FRE). This mistake stemmed from failing to double-check the alphabetical sorting and making an incorrect assumption based on earlier guesses by the Orchestrator. This initial error caused a cascading failure, with WebSurfer repeatedly searching through the FRBP for witness-related rules, which led to incorrect progress and unnecessary loops when the correct section and rule should have been in the FRE, where terms like "witnesses" are more prominent and relevant.
